Upper Text: When one of your Digimon would digivolve into this card in your hand, by returning 1 level 7 white Digimon card from your trash to the bottom of the deck, reduce the digivolution cost by 4.

[When Digivolving] [When Attacking] By returning 1 2-color card from this Digimon's digivolution cards to the bottom of the deck, trash all of the digivolution cards of 1 of your opponent's Digimon. Then, return all of your opponent's Digimon with no digivolution cards to the bottom of the deck.
